description: A script for retrieving stock data, scraping TradingView technical analysis, and displaying recommendations and tables for a set of stock tickers.

methods.name: parse_recommendation
methods.description: Parses recommendation data from HTML elements, extracting recommendation text and signal counts.

methods.name: display_recommendations
methods.description: Displays the parsed recommendation data for each analysis category.

methods.name: scrape_tables
methods.description: Extracts specific tables from HTML source using pandas read_html.

methods.name: print_tables
methods.description: Prints the oscillator, moving average, and pivots tables.
